# Code review: TxNonce shows the transaction note in the replacement label

**How this was run:** only the range `c9b7d88…HEAD` (base `3c678cb` → `ab035b7`, one commit), read-only. **I cut the pipeline short and did every pass myself, without the parallel reviewer agents or the paired validator/refuter agents.** The review rules say an unadjudicated review gets no score, so there is none here.

```
2 files, +77 −2 · base 3c678cb → HEAD ab035b7 (committed only; untracked .claude/ and docs/ excluded)
safe-wallet-monorepo · TypeScript/React (Next.js) · jest + RTL · tsc/eslint/prettier gates · stated rules: AGENTS.md, apps/web/AGENTS.md
```

## Summary

| | |
|---|---|
| Verdict | **Ready to open.** Nothing blocks it. |
| Score | None (not adjudicated) |
| Findings | 2, both P3 (low priority) |
| Fix first | Shorten the note in the dropdown with `ellipsis()`, the same way `TxSummary` does |

**What changed:** in `NonceFormOption`, the "Replace existing" option now shows the queued transaction's `note` (trimmed) first. If there is no note it falls back to `humanDescription`, then to "`<type>` transaction", then to "New transaction". Four new tests cover each branch.

## Areas

| Area | Result | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Security | 1 P3 | The proposer writes the note, and it now replaces the decoded label (see F1) |
| Bugs | clean | `note?.trim()` handles null, undefined and whitespace. The memo deps are unchanged and still correct because `note` comes from `transactions` |
| Regression | clean | `NonceFormOption` is module-private and has no other consumers. The only change is the label text |
| Testing | clean | With the change reverted, "shows the transaction note" and "treats a whitespace-only note…" both fail. The fallback and "New transaction" paths are also covered |
| Architecture | clean | Reads a field on the gateway type and doesn't import from the `tx-notes` feature |
| Performance | clean | One `trim()` inside a memo that already existed |
| DRY | 1 P3 | Duplicates the note display pattern without its truncation (see F2) |
| KISS | clean | |
| Conventions | covered by F2 | |

## Findings

**F1 · P3 · security** · `apps/web/src/components/tx-flow/common/TxNonce/index.tsx:70-73`
- **What:** the proposer writes the note as free text, and it now *replaces* the decoded `humanDescription` / type label in "Replace existing". Elsewhere a note sits *next to* the type (`TxSummary/index.tsx:82-88`) or is credited to its author, "By <proposer>" (`features/tx-notes/components/TxNote/index.tsx`).
- **Failure scenario:** a proposer, possibly a delegate, queues a transfer at nonce N with the note "Routine payroll". A signer picking a nonce to replace sees only "N - Routine payroll" and can't tell what the transaction actually does. That makes them more likely to skip replacing (cancelling) it, or to replace the wrong one.
- **Why only P3:** nothing is signed from this label, and the real transaction is still visible in the queue.
- **Fix:** show the note next to the decoded label, e.g. "`<type>` · `<note>`", instead of in its place.

**F2 · P3 · DRY/conventions** · `apps/web/src/components/tx-flow/common/TxNonce/index.tsx:70`
- **What:** the note is rendered at full length. The existing pattern is `ellipsis(tx.note, 25)` plus `title={tx.note}` (`components/transactions/TxSummary/index.tsx:85-86`).
- **Failure scenario:** the note input caps notes at 60 characters (`tx-notes` stories: `MAX_NOTE_LENGTH = 60`). `CustomPopper` removes the popper's width (`index.tsx:39`, `style={undefined}`), so a 60-character note stretches the nonce dropdown on narrow screens. I didn't check whether the backend enforces the cap, so a note sent straight to the API could be longer.
- **Fix:** use `ellipsis(note, N)` from `@safe-global/utils/utils/formatters` and put the full note in `title`.

## Not covered

- No paired validator/refuter agents ran, so both findings are my own assessment.
- No tests, type-check or lint were run, as instructed.
- I didn't check whether the backend enforces the 60-character note limit.
- No cleanup proposals.
